name: Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Family Affair'
story_html: The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Family Affair' presents a monochrome colorway of the legacy silhouette, highlighted by an olive green nubuck upper with tonal elephant print overlays at the forefoot and heel. A standard Jumpman logo is embroidered on the tongue, while raised Nike Air branding appears on the heel tab. Lightweight cushioning arrives via an off-white polyurethane midsole, featuring visible Air-sole cushioning and dark olive detailing along the heel. Underfoot, a gum rubber outsole yields durable traction.
